tasks.subject: Task 1: Add hidden_ranges table and db helpers
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Extend db.py with the hidden_ranges table and three helper functions.

**Files:**
- Modify: `db.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] hidden_ranges table created on startup if absent
- [ ] hide_range(man_slug, range_slug) inserts a row
- [ ] unhide_range(man_slug, range_slug) deletes the row
- [ ] get_hidden_ranges() returns set[tuple[str, str]]

**Verify:** `uv run python -c "import db; db.init(); db.hide_range('northstar','stargrave'); print(db.get_hidden_ranges()); db.unhide_range('northstar','stargrave'); print(db.get_hidden_ranges())"`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["db.py"], "verifyCommand": "uv run python -c \"import db; db.init(); db.hide_range('northstar','stargrave'); print(db.get_hidden_ranges()); db.unhide_range('northstar','stargrave'); print(db.get_hidden_ranges())\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["hidden_ranges table created on startup if absent", "hide_range inserts a row", "unhide_range deletes the row", "get_hidden_ranges returns set of tuples"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Add API endpoints and update /manufacturers response
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Wire up two toggle endpoints and include hidden bool in the /manufacturers JSON.

**Files:**
- Modify: `app.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] POST /api/hide-range/{man_slug}/{range_slug} returns {"ok": true}
- [ ] DELETE /api/hide-range/{man_slug}/{range_slug} returns {"ok": true}
- [ ] /manufacturers response: each range dict has a "hidden": bool key

**Verify:** curl POST then GET /manufacturers to confirm hidden:true, then DELETE and GET to confirm hidden:false

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app.py"], "verifyCommand": "curl -s -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/hide-range/northstar/stargrave && curl -s http://localhost:8000/manufacturers | python -m json.tool | grep hidden", "acceptanceCriteria": ["POST endpoint persists hidden state", "DELETE endpoint clears hidden state", "/manufacturers includes hidden bool per range"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Add hide toggle button and greyed styling to range pills
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add eye-slash button to each pill, apply greyed styling when hidden, wire toggle interaction.

**Files:**
- Modify: `templates/index.html`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Each pill has a third eye-slash button
- [ ] Pills with r.hidden render with data-hidden=1 and opacity-50
- [ ] Clicking toggles hidden via POST/DELETE and flips data-hidden without re-render
- [ ] Eye-slash button is darker when pill is hidden

**Verify:** Load home page, click eye-slash on a pill — goes muted. Reload — still muted. Click again — normal.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["templates/index.html"], "verifyCommand": "manual browser test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Eye-slash button present on every range pill", "Hidden pills render with opacity-50", "Toggle persists across page reload", "Button visually active when hidden"]}
```
